goal: Allow pruned nodes to build and query txindex without keeping full raw block history on disk
Return candidate block hashes on pruned lookups so callers can fetch missing blocks on demand
agreement: Strong support for enabling txindex on pruned nodes (ajtowns, arejula27, optout21)
Verified by code review and testing reindex and error paths on pruned nodes (optout21, l0rinc)
Prior objections on concurrency, stale blocks, and error semantics were addressed (fjahr, l0rinc)
Only minor nonblocking questions on constructor clarity and test setup remain (fjahr, optout21, arejula27)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it fulfills long-standing feature requests to run txindex on pruned nodes
Saves hundreds of gigabytes of disk space for users needing transaction lookups

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because getrawtransaction and gettxoutproof return structured candidate block hashes on pruned misses
Allows automated callers to fetch missing pruned blocks via getblockfrompeer
